about: AMC 8, AMC 10 and AMC 12 papers from 2000 onward, linked directly to the LIVE by Po-Shen Loh archive. LIVE states that the MAA contest problems are hosted with official MAA permission. Worked solutions are curated/published by LIVE by Po-Shen Loh and are not presented as official MAA solutions. Earlier AHSME editions and AIME are excluded. Only contest pages and PDF links actually published in the source archive are listed.

source.permission_notice: American Mathematics Competitions (AMC) problems are used with official permission of the Mathematical Association of America (MAA).
source.solutions_status: LIVE worked solutions; not claimed to be official MAA solutions
source.storage: direct links only; PDFs are not mirrored or copied
